title: German Windhund bomber-tracking technology
summary: Nick Cook tells of German Windhund bomber-tracking technology, about World War II at Germany, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: there was one I seem to remember called the German name was Windhund,

plain: An aviation writer named Nick Cook, on Jesse Michels's podcast, recalls a German technology from the Second World War that was used to track enemy bombers. He says he seems to remember that its German name was Windhund, which means greyhound.
